family: The single total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md and family.py. For actual length N, choose k as the least prime at least the least positive B with B^5>4*N^3; read k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject invalid Q by the exact Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 for N=0 or the explicit failed guards in proof.md. The output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. All k prefix bits are included in N; Q is input, not advice.
theorem: For this one fixed total language in P (hence NP with empty witnesses), C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(12923/1000)N^(4/5) at every sufficiently large integer actual length N in the full pinned B2 model. The same theorem implies liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. The unconditional standard prime number theorem is used only in the eventual loss estimate.
